protectionFunctions.body:
SELECT u.id,u.kind,u.state,u.auth_epoch,s.method,s.assurance,s.authenticated_at,s.reauthenticated_at,s.expires_at
        FROM public.application_session s JOIN public.app_user u ON u.id=s.user_id
        JOIN public.external_identity e ON e.issuer=s.external_issuer AND e.subject=s.external_subject AND e.user_id=u.id
        WHERE s.token_hash=p_digest AND u.state='active' AND s.auth_epoch=u.auth_epoch
          AND s.revoked_at IS NULL AND s.expires_at>statement_timestamp() AND s.last_seen_at>statement_timestamp()-interval '30 minutes'
          AND s.method='oidc' AND e.enabled AND e.binding_version=s.binding_version
          AND EXISTS (SELECT FROM public.oidc_provider p WHERE p.issuer=e.issuer AND p.enabled AND p.version=s.provider_version)

views.iam_account:
SELECT id,
    state
   FROM app_user
  WHERE (kind = 'iam'::text);
views.account_directory:
SELECT u.id,
    u.email_canonical AS email,
    u.state,
        CASE
            WHEN (e.user_id IS NULL) THEN NULL::text
            WHEN (e.expires_at > statement_timestamp()) THEN 'pending'::text
            ELSE 'expired'::text
        END AS enrollment
   FROM (app_user u
     LEFT JOIN oidc_email_enrollment e ON ((e.user_id = u.id)))
  WHERE (u.kind = 'iam'::text);
views.hr_employee_lead:
SELECT m.employee_id,
    e.account_id AS lead_account_id
   FROM ((team_membership m
     JOIN team_lead_assignment l ON ((l.team_id = m.team_id)))
     JOIN employee e ON ((e.id = l.lead_employee_id)))
  WHERE ((e.account_id IS NOT NULL) AND (m.starts_at <= statement_timestamp()) AND ((m.ends_at IS NULL) OR (m.ends_at > statement_timestamp())) AND (l.starts_at <= statement_timestamp()) AND ((l.ends_at IS NULL) OR (l.ends_at > statement_timestamp())));
views.hr_request_decider:
SELECT request_id,
    actor_account_id
   FROM request_decision d
  WHERE (actor_kind = 'user'::text);
views.hr_request_lead:
SELECT r.id AS request_id,
    e.account_id AS lead_account_id
   FROM (((work_request r
     JOIN team_membership m ON (((m.employee_id = r.employee_id) AND (m.starts_at <= statement_timestamp()) AND ((m.ends_at IS NULL) OR (m.ends_at > statement_timestamp())) AND ((m.team_id = r.team_id) OR (m.is_primary AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM team_membership c
          WHERE ((c.employee_id = r.employee_id) AND (c.team_id = r.team_id) AND (c.starts_at <= statement_timestamp()) AND ((c.ends_at IS NULL) OR (c.ends_at > statement_timestamp())))))))))))
     JOIN team_lead_assignment l ON (((l.team_id = m.team_id) AND (l.starts_at <= statement_timestamp()) AND ((l.ends_at IS NULL) OR (l.ends_at > statement_timestamp())))))
     JOIN employee e ON ((e.id = l.lead_employee_id)))
  WHERE (e.account_id IS NOT NULL);
views.hr_request_owner:
SELECT r.id AS request_id,
    e.account_id
   FROM (work_request r
     JOIN employee e ON ((e.id = r.employee_id)))
  WHERE (e.account_id IS NOT NULL);
views.hr_team_lead:
SELECT l.team_id,
    e.account_id AS lead_account_id
   FROM (team_lead_assignment l
     JOIN employee e ON ((e.id = l.lead_employee_id)))
  WHERE ((e.account_id IS NOT NULL) AND (l.starts_at <= statement_timestamp()) AND ((l.ends_at IS NULL) OR (l.ends_at > statement_timestamp())));
views.hr_employee_owner:
SELECT id AS employee_id,
    account_id
   FROM employee e
  WHERE (account_id IS NOT NULL);
views.hr_leave_rate_owner:
SELECT r.id AS rate_id,
    e.account_id
   FROM (leave_rate r
     JOIN employee e ON ((e.id = r.employee_id)))
  WHERE (e.account_id IS NOT NULL);
views.hr_request_lead_rejected:
SELECT id AS request_id,
    owner_account_id
   FROM work_request r
  WHERE ((state = 'rejected'::text) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM request_decision d
          WHERE ((d.request_id = r.id) AND (d.stage = 'lead'::text) AND (d.decision = 'reject'::text) AND (d.actor_kind = 'user'::text)))) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM team_lead_assignment l
          WHERE ((l.lead_employee_id = r.employee_id) AND (l.starts_at <= statement_timestamp()) AND ((l.ends_at IS NULL) OR (l.ends_at > statement_timestamp()))))));
views.hr_team_member:
SELECT m.team_id,
    e.account_id
   FROM (team_membership m
     JOIN employee e ON ((e.id = m.employee_id)))
  WHERE ((e.account_id IS NOT NULL) AND (m.starts_at <= statement_timestamp()) AND ((m.ends_at IS NULL) OR (m.ends_at > statement_timestamp())));
